content.title: All retained child caches and actual native producer footprint rules checked
content.text:
Checked code cbcfe429699b633a44075726e6c6218925ad5c90 follows five small proof commits. All five final public gates pass: strict checks for 9 changed modules, 22 independent probes, 96,813 aggregate dependencies and 249 explicit reports (246 standard, 3 axiom-free). Source/config hashes remain unchanged. Jobs use the pinned Nix shell, 8 GiB memory/high, zero swap and one Lean thread. The earlier full rebuild hit its actual 30-minute cap; its unchanged-source continuation passed using the retained public cache.

Actual retained-child coverage now includes every result tag with some returned cache, including empty incoming-sentinel writes and fold rejection. Actual stored-parent preparation derives input avoidance and resources before any child result. Complete class protection composes from captured through returned state. All original observation fields and supplied budgets remain. Cache-none stops are not converted into successful returned caches. The preparation refactor removes 28 duplicated lines and retains old public headers.

The existing Returned law is reused. Actual weak-physical node/edge ready hits recover the exact stored result property; finishes retain prior properties and store a locally proved producer law. The actual evaluated empty/self node branches now derive exact results, finish cells and endpoints. Their cache-property proof covers EVERY supplied fuel, including the finished cache before overall Done. The actual checked edge body derives accepted child walks, real allocated constraints, exact results/endpoints and only-U children from a smaller actual-child IH. Its IH retains literal prefixes and continuations of THIS same execution, not arbitrary valid warm caches. Sentinels have no atoms. These are intermediate producers; other recursive node families and full partial/stopped memo-history propagation remain OPEN.

Stopped-path source audit: a failed child receipt skips its deferred tuple tail; captured stopped receipts do not invoke continueWith. Retained empty rejection can advance to another captured alternative. Completed hooks may later stop while retaining earlier outputs/clears. These are source reductions, not a new checked global lineage theorem.

Recursive A/M design audit: reuse Returned with authentic past entry witnesses. Domain identity pairs do not retain the full original non-Mu pattern or its height. Arbitrary same-ID existential patterns are unsound; actual entry ancestry and common-heap availability are needed. Fixed-source SeenCovered/reachable_original/node_prefix facts are useful but do not yet establish every genuine M request's role, exact domain continuation and strict reference-height bound. No stronger thunk-validity or future model provider is added.

The constructive structural readback completion and original-U/canonical-domain/whole-prefix-free-bucket components remain checked. Biggest open target: ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME original emitted partial root under ONE compatible assignment satisfying actual domains, aliases, paths, residuals, readback and EVERY historical removed obligation on THAT output branch. Preserve original fuels/budgets, noStop/all outcomes and earlier emissions after later stops. Whole source/resource induction, full completeness/API contracts and compiled Haskell correspondence remain open. No Haskell file changed and no runtime defect/fix is claimed. Preserve raw failed drafts, elaboration repairs, original headers and all input logs. Removed 5,590,312 bytes of obsolete terminal private objects after public replacements passed; durable inputs and .lake remain. Compact lossless checkpoint follows. Goal ACTIVE.
